product: A block-coding toy that teaches children to program.

roles.name: Buying parent
roles.decision: You pay for it and decide whether it comes into the house.
roles.how: Looks for safety, screen time limits and real learning value. Reads reviews.

roles.name: Child user
roles.decision: Your parent decides. You can ask, you cannot buy it yourself.
roles.how: Wants it to be fun and quick to start. Gets bored with slow tutorials.

roles.name: Friend with a child who owns one
roles.decision: You do not buy it for your child's friend. Other parents ask you what to get.
roles.how: Talks to other parents, trusts what they have seen work at home.

objections: Will it add to screen time?
Is it worth the price for something that might be left in a drawer?
Will my child get bored after a week?
How long does the battery last?
habits: plays games on a tablet in the evening
goes to the park on weekends
